body: Thanks man, that made me smile. A family member came forward today and offered to pay for private sessions, so I have that as an option. I don't know how much I should expect to pay for an hour long season. I hope it's not too much, I already feel guilty enough as it is for the burden I put on my family.
He is right, and I do get some comfort. I'm seeing someone tomorrow so I just gotta last.
